description: Decision problems to research for TSS audiences. These are editorial directions, not factual claims about every audience member.

needs.decisionProblem: Understand the complete acquisition cost rather than only the advertised price.
Test whether an investment still works under weaker occupancy, demand or pricing assumptions.
Know which legal, title, charge and permit checks belong before commitment.
Compare countries using the same measure, period and asset type.
Match an opportunity to objective, budget, timeframe and risk tolerance.
Validate a real customer problem before committing capital or building a route to market.
Assess what a local or investment partner can actually deliver beyond capital.
Identify what pricing, delivery or customer experience must change between markets.
Separate tax headlines from the broader cost and practicality of operating a business.
Understand residence tests, exceptions and cross-border implications before moving.
Estimate housing costs using measures relevant to a newcomer and the intended city.
Compare a personal monthly basket rather than relying on a generic national ranking.
Separate measured migration or cost data from unsupported claims about why people move.
